turnaroundCommon:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production character turnaround for the Rail Arena 3D modeling reference pack.
Use the attached APPROVED CONCEPT as the design authority. Match the polished low-poly, high-detail game art quality of that image, NOT a crude geometric mannequin. Preserve this specific character's identity, face, hair, armor silhouette, colors, accessories and layered tailoring. Adult athletic anatomy, roughly 7.5 heads tall, expressive anatomically sculpted face, sophisticated overlapping polygonal hair locks, crisp beveled armor, articulated dark fabric joints, finely finished gloves and athletic boots. No redesign.
Create ONE very high-resolution landscape contact sheet with EXACTLY EIGHT equal-sized, fully visible head-to-sole orthographic turnaround views of ONE AND THE SAME character in a 4 column x 2 row grid. Stable relaxed A pose: arms 25 degrees away from torso, fingers separated naturally, legs straight, parallel feet, no contrapposto. The body, equipment and pose are a single locked object rotated in place, never redrawn as different costume variants. Same body scale, head height and soles baseline within each row, same neutral soft studio lighting. Character fills each cell with clear silhouette and modest gutters, light warm gray background, no perspective or foreshortening in cardinal views, no dramatic shadows.
Top row: FRONT; FRONT-RIGHT 45; RIGHT PROFILE; BACK-RIGHT 45.
Bottom row: BACK; BACK-LEFT 45; LEFT PROFILE; FRONT-LEFT 45.
RIGHT and LEFT mean the CHARACTER'S anatomical sides, not image sides. In RIGHT PROFILE the nose points to the RIGHT edge of the sheet; LEFT PROFILE nose points LEFT. Back views show the back, never duplicated fronts. Hair silhouette, glove cuffs, armor seams, knee guards, boots, belt pouches, cloth split panels must agree spatially in all eight rotations. Label each cell with exactly the corresponding view text, plus a small restrained character title. No cropped feet, no weapons, no bonus characters, no new cybernetic parts, no numbered measurements, no floating accessories, no invented text paragraphs. Treat this as a careful multi-view reconstruction of the approved character.

designs.Player: Character title: PLAYER. Select ONLY the first male ivory-and-cyan player from the attached approved sheet and the player details in its lower half. Warm medium-light tan skin, angular youthful adult male face, dark eyes, thick stern brows, dark brown swept spiky layered hair, strong tapered jaw, clean shaven. Teal folded scarf wraps the neck with short layered front V folds and a thick rear cowl, no long tail. Ivory/champagne beveled shoulder shells and shaped ivory chest plate over charcoal segmented suit, small restrained cyan inset strips at shoulders/chest/wrists/knees/ankles, gray metal buckles. Two matching mid-thigh dark cloth panels bordered with broad ivory strips, dark trouser thighs and shins with ivory angular knee guards and small shin armor. Compact dark belt pouches at both sides, central rectangular gray buckle. Black fingerless gloves, ivory armored forearm bracers, fitted dark athletic armored boots with ivory toe/heel/ankle shell pieces. Back: use the existing player BACK inset as authority: compact ivory scapular/back plate with small cyan marks, teal rear cowl, dark spine below, no backpack, no cape. Balanced bilateral armor; do not introduce a diagonal chest sash.
designs.Bot01: Character title: BOT 01. Select ONLY the second character, the terracotta-and-amber athletic adult WOMAN. Warm medium tan skin, slim angular female face, dark eyes, stern brows, dark brown-black hair gathered into a high compact swept bun with asymmetric forehead locks and short face-framing strands; maintain her recognizable feminine facial anatomy without glamor makeup. Charcoal close-fitting neck guard/scarf with amber rim, terracotta/rust orange beveled shoulders and fitted continuous segmented chest armor, amber/gold slim trim at upper arms, wrist cuffs, outer thigh panels, angular knees and boot edges. Charcoal articulated undersuit with black trouser legs. Terracotta paired split thigh-length cloth/armor tabs, a rectangular compact dark utility holster/pouch mounted on HER RIGHT outer upper thigh (viewer LEFT in front view); keep that exact anatomical side in all angles. Small dark belt pouches, dark belt and central brass rectangular buckle. Rust armored bracers, black fingerless gloves, dark fitted boots with rust guards and amber trim. Front chest is rust plates with small dark seams, no large glowing V symbol. Back is a restrained matching terracotta upper-back plate on dark fitted suit, amber seam accents, compact bun above dark collar; no backpack or cape, no long scarf tails. Rear details are a consistent continuation of the approved front design, not a new outfit.
designs.Bot02: Character title: BOT 02. Select ONLY the third character, the pale-haired teal/slate male. Fair warm skin, angular adult male face with strong jaw, dark eyes and stern brows, pale platinum blond swept layered spiky hair with cream shadows, clean shaven. Dark teal folded scarf/cowl. Slate/teal shaped chest shell with IVORY/SILVER shoulder armor, IVORY/SILVER clavicle reinforcement plates framing the upper chest, IVORY/SILVER forearm bracers, IVORY/SILVER angular knee shells. Dark teal/slate mid-thigh split coat panels with pale borders over charcoal and dark-teal suit, black articulated joints. Dark belt, central gray rectangular buckle, paired compact dark side pouches. Black fingerless gloves, fitted black armored athletic boots with pale toe/heel shells and small teal accents. Restrained cyan/teal narrow accents, never bright red/amber. Back continues the pale shoulder/yoke reinforcement, slate upper-back panel, teal rear scarf, dark spine with small teal inset, no backpack/cape/long scarf tail. Same costume throughout, not a recolor of the ivory player.
designs.Bot03: Character title: BOT 03. Select ONLY the fourth character, the dark-skinned plum/copper athletic adult WOMAN. Deep warm brown skin, sharply defined adult feminine face, dark brown eyes, strong brows, full natural lips, sculpted cheekbones. Thick charcoal-black locs sweep predominantly over HER RIGHT temple (viewer LEFT in front view), HER LEFT temple is closely cropped with neat parallel shaved rows; maintain this asymmetry and the same loc lengths in every view. Plum/aubergine layered shoulder and chest armor over charcoal fitted suit, small warm copper/brass hardware, edging and wrist guards, compact dark high collar, no teal scarf. Dark belt, copper central rectangular buckle and side utility pouches. Split asymmetric plum thigh panels: HER LEFT outer thigh has a short angular copper-edged plum flap, HER RIGHT has the longer vertical plum panel. Keep these anatomical sides fixed. Plum angular knee guards and fitted dark boots with plum shell pieces and copper toe/heel trim, black fingerless gloves. Compact dark shoulder harness with copper fasteners, but NO large diagonal copper stripe across the chest, no glowing orange V. Back: restrained plum upper-back plates and dark harness, matching asymmetric locs and thigh flaps, no backpack, cape, new insignia or long tail. Preserve the approved woman's identity, not a male body with a female hairstyle.

detailsCommonFinal:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE very high-resolution LANDSCAPE modeling construction/detail sheet for the SAME exact Rail Arena character. Image 1 is the approved original identity/style authority. Image 2 is the eight-view turnaround and locked costume geometry authority; match its exact character, face, hair, armor, colors and accessories. This is additional coverage of the same design, NEVER a redesign. Do NOT copy the crude existing game models.
Use a clean 4-column by 3-row grid, twelve equally generous cards, warm light gray neutral background, restrained thin dividers, soft neutral studio light, polished high-detail low-poly game art with confident planar sculpture. Fill cells well, keep all details uncropped and legible. Orthographic-style technical views with no wide-angle distortion. Only the brief panel labels below; no invented measurement values, no new logos, no weapons, no detached armor floating over the body.
Top row, four matching-scale head/neck close-ups, exact same person: HEAD FRONT; HEAD RIGHT (nose toward RIGHT edge); HEAD LEFT (nose LEFT); HEAD BACK. Show the complete hair volume, ears and jaw/collar transition, serious neutral expression. Maintain hair part and asymmetry without mirroring identity.
Middle row four cards: HEAD TOP (true overhead crown and hair flow); BODY HIGH ANGLE (steep overhead three-quarter inspection of the same neutral A-pose body, showing shoulder/forearm/chest/back depth relationships); BODY LOW ANGLE (steep upward three-quarter inspection of same A-pose, showing both boot soles, palms and underside armor; not a second frontal pose); RIGHT GLOVE (two orthographic close-ups side by side of the exact same right glove, BACK OF HAND and PALM, naturally straight spread fingers, exactly five fingers each, fingerless tips, cuff and knuckle plates consistent).
Bottom row four cards: RIGHT BOOT (outer and inner profile side by side, same right foot equipment, accurate ankle closures: outer profile toe points RIGHT; inner profile toe points LEFT, one is a viewpoint from the opposite side, not two copies of the outer view); BOOT TOP / SOLE (true top and true underside of that same boot side by side, distinct labeled silhouettes and believable matching tread); TORSO FRONT / BACK (close-ups of both sides of the exact fitted chest shell, collar and scapular plates, retain all straps/seams); BELT / HIP PANELS (front and back waist-to-mid-thigh views with belt buckle, pouches and exact anatomical-side asymmetries).
Every card must agree with Image 2. New hidden surfaces must be a restrained physically plausible continuation of the existing costume, not additional accessories. In the glove/boot pairs keep equipment on the same anatomical limb; never substitute another costume or use a mirrored asymmetric part. Tread, glove palm and overhead construction are new design extensions for modeling and should look manufacturable within this stylized game design. Preserve original adult proportions and facial appeal.
headCommon:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a large anatomical HEAD AND HAIR construction sheet for Rail Arena. Image 1 is the original approved character identity/style; image 2 is the final full-body turnaround; image 3 is the detail-sheet face/costume authority. Depict ONLY THE SAME EXACT character's head, full hair volume, ears, neck and collar, cropped above the chest. Match their face identity and hair part/locks, proportions, skin/hair/eye colors and existing scarf/collar. No redesign and no beauty variation between panels.
Create a PORTRAIT 2 COLUMN x 3 ROW sheet with SIX large clear same-scale views, restrained labels and thin dividers, warm light gray background, neutral even lighting, high quality finely sculpted low-poly art matching the original concept. Head occupies most of each cell with enough margin for all hair. Neutral closed mouth, serious relaxed eyes, adult anatomy, accurate ears, clear nose, cheek/jaw planes and lips, interlocking sculpted hair clumps. No neck pose changes, no expressive smile, no jewelry or new markings.
Row1: HEAD FRONT; HEAD RIGHT.
Row2: HEAD BACK; HEAD LEFT.
Row3: CROWN; UNDER JAW.
HEAD FRONT is strict frontal. HEAD RIGHT is exact 90-degree profile with NO far eye and nose pointing RIGHT; HEAD LEFT exact profile nose pointing LEFT; HEAD BACK exact rear with neither eye/nose visible. All four share ear/jaw/brow/chin landmark heights in their cells.
CROWN is a TRUE VERTICAL overhead orthographic view down the head's upright axis. Show only the hair crown, ears and collar edges where visible. Eyes, cheeks and mouth must be fully occluded by the head, not visible as an angled portrait.
UNDER JAW is a TRUE VERTICAL orthographic view from directly below the upright head, with a short flat neck stump occluding the center underside. Show the underside of the mandibular jaw, chin, underside of nose/nostrils at its forward edge, ear undersides and hair ends where exposed. DO NOT draw a normal frontal portrait tilted backward. This must be an anatomical underside/cutoff-neck inspection, useful to model the jaw-neck junction.
Both polar views keep the same head, nose size and hair silhouette, no invented anatomy. Treat it as the six cardinal viewport directions of a single finished head sculpt. Keep collars identical to the existing body references.

rejectedAxialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Rail Arena AXIAL CONSTRUCTION reference sheet, complementing the four attached eight-view turnarounds. Image 1 = Player ivory/teal/cyan male; Image 2 = Bot01 rust/amber woman; Image 3 = Bot02 platinum-haired slate/pale male; Image 4 = Bot03 deep brown-skinned plum/copper woman with locs on anatomical RIGHT and cropped LEFT temple. Match their precise costumes and silhouettes. No redesign.
Create landscape 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, only EIGHT views. Columns titled PLAYER, BOT 01, BOT 02, BOT 03. Top row labeled TRUE TOP; bottom row labeled TRUE UNDERSIDE. This is a modeling PLAN VIEW, NOT a dramatic perspective picture. A single locked neutral standing A-pose is projected along its vertical axis. CAMERA IS EXACTLY 90 DEGREES ABOVE for every TOP view and EXACTLY 90 DEGREES BELOW for every UNDERSIDE view. Orthographic projection, zero perspective. All characters stand straight; feet parallel with soles on same horizontal plane; arms away from torso at 25 degrees; fingers open naturally.
CRITICAL projection appearance: because camera is vertical, the character's standing HEIGHT COLLAPSES in the image. The whole body must look like a compact wide overhead/underfoot silhouette, NOT like a standing person seen at an angle. Do not show the full length of vertical torsos or trouser legs. The TOP shows mainly HAIR CROWN, SHOULDER TOPS, upper surfaces of arms and forearms, glove backs and small protruding toe tips. The head/shoulders OCCLUDE the waist and legs. No visible faces, eyes, noses, front chest armor or long legs in TOP. The UNDERSIDE shows primarily two complete treaded BOOT SOLES in the foreground, undersides of palms and forearms to the sides, and only narrow underside/crotch/torso glimpses where the soles do not occlude them. No standing front view, no full-length chest, no face or hair crown in UNDERSIDE. Think 3D CAD top/bottom viewport projections, not a character illustration tilted toward the viewer.
Front/toe direction points DOWN the sheet in each TOP cell; UNDERSIDE has the same front/toe-down orientation, meaning anatomical sides swap screen positions under the correct camera rotation. Add tiny R / L side tags in each cell: TOP anatomical R on image LEFT and L on image RIGHT; UNDERSIDE R on image RIGHT and L on image LEFT. No long annotations or invented dimensions.
The same precisely shaped costumes from the attached references must remain: ivory player shells and cyan heel insert; rust/amber Bot01 with a single RIGHT thigh holster hidden where occluded; slate/ivory Bot02; plum/copper Bot03 with long RIGHT-side locs and cropped LEFT. Shoulder widths and boot shape must agree with their turnaround views, preserve physically correct occlusion. Smooth neutral lighting reveals planar armor and hair structure; light gray background, thin grid. High detail and legible boot tread. This sheet exists to inspect depth and occlusion at the two poles of rotation, not to showcase a full standing silhouette.
